run_mrp_main: run the mrp CLI entrypoint to start all defined processes in the msetup file
define_conda_process: define a named process that runs a Python script inside a Conda environment with specified dependencies
define_docker_x11_process: define a named process that runs inside a Docker container with X11 display forwarding via mount and env
define_docker_opengl_process: define a named process that runs inside a Docker container with NVIDIA GPU runtime and X11 forwarding
configure_process_env: configure environment variables for an mrp process using the env dict parameter on mrp.process
